common_discrete_operators.dynamic_steric: symmetric ordered boundary-vertex to complete closed target-surface operator with one global closest-feature owner and winding-number signed physical distance
common_discrete_operators.steric_ECM_surface: exterior ECM boundary triangles and their incident boundary vertices only
common_discrete_operators.steric_target_validity: every current target boundary remains an embedded oriented closed surface without proper self-intersection; ECM also requires J>0
common_discrete_operators.steric_proper_intersection_guard: continuous triangle-triangle collision detection rejects any trial path with an unpenalized proper crossing
common_discrete_operators.material_adhesion: frozen full-coverage material registry using delta_g=g-g0_pair
common_discrete_operators.adhesion_compression_policy: tension-only adhesion with intentional zero-normal-force slack for 0<=g<g0_pair; physical steric starts only for g<0
common_discrete_operators.blood_load: one current-area barycenter quadrature per apical triangle; one-third nodal force weights; resultant leakage and power use the same assembled nodal force block
common_discrete_operators.myocardial_source_map: one hashed record per myocardial basal master face to the unique boundary-adjacent ECM tetra; j_myo and assembly are zero
common_discrete_operators.force: complete negative nodal gradient of the selected discrete potential

registered_interpretation_caveats.adhesion_compression_slack: Closing a natural adhesive gap does not generate normal compression force until physical overlap g<0 activates steric repulsion.
registered_interpretation_caveats.flow_sensor: chi_E is one global filter of the unprojected prescribed WSS command magnitude; it is not a local cell/face shear sensor and has no mechanical feedback.

gates.name: single_myocardial_cell
gates.question: Does the sole preferred-length controller shorten one myocardial DCM cell with central forces, compatible transverse response, volume control and a closed ledger?
gates.falsifier: Shortening depends on passive gamma, produces noncentral torque, or violates energy/volume/residual thresholds.

gates.name: myocardial_cell_chain
gates.question: Can three independent myocardial cells transfer a prescribed mechanical phase sequence while dynamic steric and natural-gap material tethers remain objective and balanced?
gates.falsifier: Tether identity changes, a disjoint state acquires negative signed distance, penetration persists, a proper intersection cannot be avoided, topology changes, or pair force/moment and power tests fail.

gates.name: myocardium_ECM_sandwich
gates.question: Does basal material adhesion transmit myocardial contraction to ECM without artificial normal source or environment-owner conflict?
gates.falsifier: A manual q is required, reference traction is nonzero, support ownership duplicates, source-map coverage or ownership fails, pair forces fail, or j_myo is nonzero.

gates.name: endocardium_ECM_sandwich
gates.question: Are ramped pressure and WSS assembled by the frozen current-face nodal rule only on the endocardial apical port and transferred mechanically to ECM while chi_E remains a global nonmechanical command diagnostic?
gates.falsifier: ECM receives direct blood load, force-block resultant and power disagree, pressure leaks tangentially, WSS leaks normally, fixture base power is nonzero, or chi_E enters the ledger.

gates.name: minimal_complete_patch_verification
gates.support_owner: myocardial opposite_outer and directional outward perimeter lateral faces
gates.question: Can the 6-endocardial-cell, ECM and 9-myocardial-cell base patch close reference, topology, ownership, resultant, contact, time-refinement and power checks?
gates.falsifier: A fully fixed boundary, periodic constraint or unregistered source is needed, or any registered primary metric fails.
gates.claim_guard: Passing the sealed base/fine response comparison is mechanistic verification only and is not physiological validation.
